provenanceBasis: The source-page and image URL pairs were supplied as previously verified first-party sources. Only these image URLs were downloaded; no broader research or third-party channel-resource collection was used. All final download URLs matched the requested assetUrl.
permissionNotes: Public availability establishes provenance, NOT trademark permission. Marks remain the property of their respective owners. No endorsement, affiliation, active service integration, or authorization is claimed. Trademark/brand-guideline approval review remains required before release or distribution.
additionNotes: 2026-10-25 batch: nine previously-pending channels were filled using Wikimedia Commons official brand logos (resolved via the Commons API, downloaded unmodified) and first-party brand sites (snap.com, tigergpt.com). Each file's bytes were checked: SVG XML root plus no script/event-handler/external-reference scan; PNG signature, chunk/CRC and IDAT zlib decompression. Seven channels remain on the neutral placeholder; see fallbackChannels.pending.

statusMeaning.verified: A supplied first-party image was downloaded and its actual bytes passed local validation; this is not permission or integration verification.
statusMeaning.pending: No confirmed, accepted local artwork; render only the neutral generic grid.
statusMeaning.retired: Retired consumer service; render only the neutral generic grid.
statusMeaning.custom: User-defined channel; use escaped custom-avatar text if supplied, otherwise the neutral generic grid.

renderingRules.signalNotes: The glyph fills the SVG viewBox. Retain its original local light/dark color-scheme rules; do not add recoloring. Integration must not clip the minimum-size glyph.
renderingRules.fallback: Neutral four-cell grid, never invented letters or brand imitations.
renderingRules.customAvatar: Escaped text, not HTML or an image URL; takes priority over official and fallback artwork.

png: Actual PNG signature checked independently of extension and HTTP content type.
Chunk boundaries and CRCs checked; IHDR dimensions checked.
IDAT zlib stream decompressed successfully with a size limit.
IEND present and no trailing bytes.
svg: UTF-8 XML parsed with an SVG root and a static-element allowlist.
No scripts, event-handler attributes, external href, remote CSS, foreignObject, or animation elements.
No DTD/entity declarations, non-XML processing instructions, or resource base/src attributes.
CSS URLs must be local fragment references; obfuscated CSS and remote imports rejected.
Signal's two original prefers-color-scheme rules were separately checked against a strict local fill-only rule pattern.
validation.rejectionPolicy: Reject unsafe or invalid artwork; never sanitize or alter the downloaded artwork to force acceptance.
validation.scope: Asset-byte checks only; application integration and application-level tests are not completed by this asset manifest.
